{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ritual of Blue Vertex''' was a rite performed by the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] where they granted the title of ''"Red Rhombus"'' to those that had performed a great act in service to the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]].

[[Gatemaster]] [[Beltek'k]] gave the award of ''"Red Rhombus"'' to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] spacers after [[Kephess]] was defeated on [[Asation]] during the [[Hypergate]] crisis.
